I added a safety check (guard) in `src/payments.ts` to stop duplicates, and the 3 targeted unit tests (isolated code checks) passed. I have not yet run the full integration suite (tests checking how multiple components work together) or looked at live production traffic.

The safety check may stop duplicate processing, but we have not verified it under concurrent requests (multiple requests hitting the system at the exact same time).

Next step: Run the concurrency test before deciding to deploy (release changes live). Nothing has been deployed yet.
